QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: useGeoMapEngine
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Use the experimental GeoMap 2D/3D engine for the Fly View map (preview feature).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Use GeoMap engine (preview)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: geoMapDebugUI
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show the GeoMap engine debug controls and terrain stats overlay.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show GeoMap engine debug UI

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMinimumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Minimum altitude allowed for guided mode actions like takeoff and altitude changes.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Minimum Altitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: guidedMaximumAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum altitude allowed for guided mode actions like takeoff and altitude changes.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Maximum Altitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showLogReplayStatusBar
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show the playback control bar during telemetry log replay.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show Telemetry Log Replay Status Bar

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showAdditionalIndicatorsCompass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Display additional heading reference indicators on the compass.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show additional heading indicators on Compass

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: lockNoseUpCompass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Always show north pointing up on the compass instead of rotating with vehicle heading.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Lock Compass Nose-Up

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: keepMapCenteredOnVehicle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Automatically pan the map to keep the vehicle centered on screen during flight.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Keep Map Centered On Vehicle

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showSimpleCameraControl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Display simple camera trigger controls using MAVLink DIGICAM_CONTROL commands.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show simple camera controls (DIGICAM_CONTROL)

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showObstacleDistanceOverlay
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show obstacle distance overlay on map and video.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show obstacle distance overlay on map and video.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: lastEstimatorOriginLatitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Latitude of the estimator origin last set, offered as a starting point next time.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Last estimator origin latitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: lastEstimatorOriginLongitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Longitude of the estimator origin last set, offered as a starting point next time.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Last estimator origin longitude

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: localGridPlanAnchorVehicleId
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: MAVLink system id the stored plan anchor below was recorded against. Zero means none, and an id that does not match the connected vehicle makes the anchor be ignored -- a plan moved under one aircraft says nothing about another one's.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Local grid plan anchor vehicle id

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: localGridPlanAnchorNorth
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Metres north of the estimator origin that the local grid plan's pattern was last moved to start from, so a plan moved before a restart is not moved by the whole distance again afterwards.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Local grid plan anchor north

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: localGridPlanAnchorEast
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Metres east of the estimator origin that the local grid plan's pattern was last moved to start from.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Local grid plan anchor east

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showLocalGridView
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Replace the fly view map with a local NED grid measured in metres.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show local grid view

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showLocalGridPlanHelp
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show the background notes on the local grid's mission item editor.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show local grid plan help

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: showNonGpsStatusPanel
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show the non-GPS status panel on the fly view map.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show non-GPS status panel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: maxGoToLocationDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Maximum allowed distance for go-to-location commands from the vehicle.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Go To Location Max Distance

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: forwardFlightGoToLocationLoiterRad
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Loiter radius when circling a go-to destination during fixed-wing flight. (ArduPilot only)
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Loiter Radius in Forward Flight Guided Mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: goToLocationRequiresConfirmInGuided
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Require explicit confirmation for go-to-location commands while in Guided mode.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Require Confirmation for Go To Location in Guided Mode

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: updateHomePosition
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Automatically update the vehicle return-to-home position from the GCS GPS location.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Update return to home position based on device location

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: instrumentQmlFile2
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Select the instrument panel display style for the Fly view.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Integrated Compass & Attitude,Horizontal Compass & Attitude,Large Vertical
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Qml file for instrument panel

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requestControlAllowTakeover
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: When requesting vehicle control, allow other GCS to override control automatically, or require this GCS to accept the request first.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: When requesting vehicle control, allow other GCS to override control automatically, or require this GCS to accept the request first.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requestControlTimeout
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Timeout in seconds before a request to a GCS to allow takeover is assumed to be rejected. This is used to display the timeout graphically on requestor and GCS in control.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Timeout in seconds before a request to a GCS to allow takeover is assumed to be rejected. This is used to display the timeout graphically on requestor and GCS in control.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: enableAutomaticMissionPopups
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Automatically show mission start and resume confirmation dialogs.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable automatic mission start/resume popups
